niche_preference_profile: This user prefers dense-but-organized utility screens with clear section hierarchy, visible actions, and complete information. They like layouts that feel finished and actionable rather than sparse or decorative, with strong labels, explicit controls, and enough content to make the screen feel useful. Visually, they often favor light or airy backgrounds, but in some contexts they also prefer dark, high-contrast surfaces and urgent accent colors when the task is transactional or warning-oriented.

criteria.description: Clear section structure with strong visual separation, obvious headings, and a title-first layout that makes the page easy to scan.
Screens that feel fully populated and finished, with enough visible items, settings, or details to avoid a sparse or incomplete feel.
Prominent, easy-to-find primary actions and item-level controls, including clear buttons, toggles, chevrons, and inline actions.
A compact but not cramped layout with balanced spacing, minimal wasted empty space, and enough density to feel useful.
Direct, task-focused labels and explanatory text that are specific rather than generic, making the next step or setting immediately understandable.
Clean card-based or row-based interfaces with subtle separators, simple structure, and a polished app-like presentation rather than decorative or promotional styling.
